glossary.ja: ディストーションフィールド
glossary.role: Nadesico's gravity-wave barrier; also the Aestivalis/Nadesico-unit defensive weapon in the tutorial.
Poseidal-side planetary cruiser; Giwaza Lowau's flagship class. ACE2 Op 23 objective: 'Destroy Sarge Opus'.
Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
Network of (hundreds of) orbital military satellite cannons of the Rainen Project; Gun Ark/Buster Ark can call it via the Guardian System.
MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers

Daba's rival. Ambitious country noble from Koam who joins the Poseidal military (under Chai Char, later one of the Thirteen); commands the Slender Skala, finally sides with Daba to rescue Quwasan. Pilots Ashura Temple, A-Taul, Bat-Shu in ACE2.
glossary.personality: Pompous and vain but sincere, warm-hearted and quick to fall in love; naive and comically airheaded, a rival with a sense of honor.

glossary.role: Giwaza Lowau's rebel fleet (mostly Sarge Opus planet cruisers of the Thirteen) that turns against Poseidal.
Daba's adopted younger sister and fiancee. Kidnapped and brainwashed by Poseidal via bio-relation; reappears as commander of Poseidal's Imperial Guard. Pilots a copper-yellow Calvary Temple.
glossary.personality: Under mind control she is cold and obedient, acting on Poseidal's orders; underneath she is fragile, and her mind breaks down by the end of the series.

glossary.role: Seat no. 3 and de facto leader of Poseidal's Thirteen, the highest-ranking officer after Poseidal; rebels against Poseidal with his own fleet (the Giwaza fleet) and is killed in the final battle.
glossary.personality: Capable, cold, calculating and ambitious; uses and discards people, including his lover Nei Mo Han; a political schemer.

glossary.role: ACE2 heroine; Ensign in Tak's squad, pilot of the red Gun Ark; goes missing at Torrington Base, reappears with the Rainen Project in the Buster Ark, later rejoins Tak.
glossary.personality: Cool and reserved ('defrosting ice queen' in flashbacks); deeply bonded with Tak.

glossary.role: Protagonist. Heir of the Yaman clan's Kamon dynasty (true name Kamon Myroad), raised on Koam; leads the rebellion against Poseidal. Pilots the L-Gaim, later the L-Gaim Mk-II.
glossary.personality: Calm, earnest and somewhat reserved, hard to read; indecisive at times but prone to sudden outbursts of anger, and reckless whenever his adopted sister Quwasan is involved. Grows into a capable leader.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

38.speaker: South Burning
38.role: Captain, mobile weapons unit commander at Torrington

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>さあ！　いよいよギワザとの決戦よ！<ab(400)><ed()>

rows.jp:

rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Captain! Thank you very much!
We safely rescued Quwasan!<ab(500)><ed()>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>で、なんでギャブレーまでついてくんのよ！<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>And why is Gablae tagging along too?!<ab(100)><ed()>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>私も貴艦に合流させていただく！<ab(100)><ed()>

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>わが愛を貫くために、
クワサンを守らねばならないのでな！<ab(700)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>To carry through my devotion,
I must protect Quwasan!<ab(700)><ed()>

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>アルビオン、こちら反乱軍！

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>あとは残った敵を片づけるだけね。<ab(300)><ed()>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>ターゲットの位置を送るわよ！<ab(500)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>All allied ship signals

<op(38,1)><sp(2)>合流した<im(5)>#c[5E8FD8]反乱<im(6)>軍#cの先行隊と
<im(11)>#c[BE5050]ギワ<im(16)>ザ艦<im(17)>隊#cと<im(18)>の戦<im(19)>闘が始まった。
我々は#c[5E8FD8]反乱軍#cの援護を行う。

<op(38,1)><sp(2)>The joined <im(5)>#c[5E8FD8]rebel <im(6)>army#c vanguard
<im(11)>#c[BE5050]and Giwa<im(16)>za <im(17)>Fleet#c are <im(18)>in <im(19)>combat.
We will support the #c[5E8FD8]rebel army#c.

rows.jp:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>しかし、<im(2)>#c[BE5050]ギワザ#cは<im(1)>この混乱に乗じて、
#c[BE5050]工業衛星#cを地球に向けて稼動させた。

rows.en:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>However, <im(2)>#c[BE5050]Giwaza#c seized <im(1)>on this chaos

rows.jp:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>何としても<im(3)>#c[F07141]ギワザ艦隊を撃破#cして

<op(38,1)><sp(2)>現在のところ、戦力的にかなり不利だが…

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op23_02, covering the conclusion of Phase 1 (Tak sortying unauthorized in the Gun Ark, Buster Ark escaping after Tak triggers the Guardian, Quwasan rescued, Gablae joining the Albion, and rebel fleet distress/escape lines), Phase 2 tactical briefing (Captain Burning detailing Giwaza dropping an industrial satellite), and Phase 2 battle dialogue (assault on the Giwaza Fleet, Nadesico Distortion Field, Layzner Rei calculation, and arrival of rebel reinforcements with low-orbit Planet Bomber).
uncertainties: m6231#78: Spoken by Burning or Sinapus directly addressing Tak.
m6232#33-35: Humorous exchange during battle attributed to Lilith Fau and Kyao Mirao referencing the Grim Reaper.
m6232#42: Planet Bomber line attributed to a stunned Giwaza officer.
